headline: RD seeks European investment to assemble chips and devices
summary: Dominican Industry and Commerce Minister Eduardo Sanz Lovatón said the country can attract European semiconductor investment and become a supplier. The government sees chip assembly and testing as areas where it can compete.
why: Semiconductor assembly and testing is a link in the global chip supply chain, where countries compete for foreign manufacturing investment.
original_headline: RD busca inversión europea para ensamblar chips y dispositivos
